title: Coconut Milk vs Coconut Cream: Why They Are Not Interchangeable

seo.title: Coconut Milk vs Coconut Cream
seo.meta_description: Coconut cream has less water and more fat than canned coconut milk, so it is thicker and more calorie-dense. Sweetened cream of coconut is a different product again.
seo.search_intent: Distinguish coconut milk, coconut cream, and sweetened cream of coconut by fat, water, and use.

excerpt: Coconut cream is more concentrated than canned coconut milk, with less water and usually more fat. It is thicker and more calorie-dense, while sweetened cream of coconut is a separate cocktail ingredient.
content_html:
Coconut milk and coconut cream come from the same raw material, but not at the same concentration. Coconut cream contains less water and more fat; canned coconut milk may run around 15–20 g fat per 100 g, while coconut cream can exceed 20–25 g.

Water is the main difference

Grated coconut meat is mixed with water and pressed. More concentrated fractions are sold as cream; more diluted fractions are sold as milk. Brands do not all use identical cutoffs, so the Nutrition Facts panel matters.

More fat means more calories

Full-fat canned coconut milk often provides roughly 150–200 calories per 100 g. Rich coconut cream can reach or exceed 220–250 calories. Light versions fall much lower because they contain more water.

A curry notices the swap

Using cream where a recipe expects milk makes the sauce richer and thicker. Using milk for cream can make it thin. Diluting cream with water or reducing milk can bring them closer, but a 1:1 swap is not neutral.

Coconut cream is not cream of coconut

In U.S. stores, cream of coconut is typically a sweetened cocktail ingredient. Unsweetened coconut cream is the concentrated cooking product. The names are similar enough to cause expensive recipe mistakes.

The shopping rule

Compare fat and added sugar, then choose the concentration your recipe needs.

faq.question: Can coconut cream replace coconut milk?
faq.answer: Yes with adjustment, such as diluting the cream with water; a straight swap changes richness and thickness.

faq.question: Which has more calories?
faq.answer: Coconut cream usually does because it contains more fat and less water.

faq.question: Is coconut cream the same as cream of coconut?
faq.answer: No. Cream of coconut is usually sweetened and intended for drinks and desserts.
